topic: Set it once: personal instructions so every Claude chat starts the way you like
post:
Still typing "keep it short" at the start of every chat? ✋
Set it once, and Claude remembers for every conversation.

Claude has account-wide instructions. Claude's help center says anything you add there "will be applied to all of your conversations with Claude."

How to set them 👇
1️⃣ Click your initials in the lower-left corner
2️⃣ Go to Settings, then "Your Claude"
3️⃣ Under Instructions, describe how you like to work

Copy-paste starter 👇
"I work in operations. Keep answers short, with bullet points. Use plain English, no jargon. When I ask for an email, keep it under 120 words and friendly. If you're unsure about a fact, say so."

What to include ✅
🧑‍💼 Your role and the work you do
📏 How long and how formal answers should be
🗣️ Words you use a lot, and words to avoid

Need different rules for one piece of work? Use project instructions instead. They only apply to chats inside that project.

Why it matters:
The best automation is the one you never have to think about. One paragraph saves you repeating yourself in every chat. 💡

What would you put in your instructions? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.

#Claude #AI #AIForBeginners #Productivity
